panels.title: In one sentence
panels.description:
Lines and pools whose term ends within 90 days (n360.settings decision_window_days), over billed, set to exceed billed before the term ends, and at renewal risk (proposed thresholds).

**Source:** n360.v_contract_status  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(concat(toString(e), if(e = 1, ' line ends', ' lines end')), ' in the next ', toString(days), ' days · ',
                      toString(o), ' over billed · ', toString(w), ' set to exceed · ', toString(r), ' at renewal risk') AS sentence
        FROM (SELECT (SELECT decision_window_days FROM n360.settings) AS days,
                     countIf(days_left BETWEEN 0 AND days) AS e, countIf(status = 'over billed') AS o,
                     countIf(status = 'will exceed') AS w, countIf(renewal_risk) AS r
              FROM n360.v_contract_status WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}))

panels.title: Data
panels.description:
The last day of usage in this load, and the day it was loaded. Amber when the data is more than 2 days old (n360.settings stamp_stale_days): the numbers are the last good night's. Click for Pipeline health.

**Source:** n360.v_freshness (n360.runs: loaded runs only)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(stamp, if(stale, concat(' · ', toString(days_old), ' days old'), '')) AS stamp FROM n360.v_freshness

panels.title: Ending in 90 days
panels.description:
Lines and pools (every one, a pool once) whose term ends within 90 days of each loaded night's data-through day (n360.settings decision_window_days).

**Source:** n360.v_contract_status, n360.runs  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the last 30 loaded nights

targets.rawSql:
WITH nightly AS (SELECT r.data_date AS night,
               toUInt64(countIf(dateDiff('day', r.data_date - 1, c.end_date) BETWEEN 0 AND (SELECT decision_window_days FROM n360.settings))) AS value
        FROM (SELECT DISTINCT data_date FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') AS r
        CROSS JOIN (SELECT end_date FROM n360.v_contract_status WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})) AS c GROUP BY night),
             (SELECT max(night) FROM nightly) AS newest,
             (SELECT max(night) FROM nightly WHERE night <= newest - 30) AS ref_30,
             (SELECT min(night) FROM nightly) AS oldest,
             if(ref_30 IS NULL OR ref_30 = toDate(0), if(oldest < newest, oldest, NULL), ref_30) AS ref,
             (SELECT any(value) FROM nightly WHERE night = newest) AS v_now,
             (SELECT any(value) FROM nightly WHERE night = ref) AS v_then
        SELECT toDateTime(night) AS time, value, if(ref IS NULL, 'no earlier night stored', concat(multiIf(v_now > v_then, concat('+', toString(v_now - v_then)), v_now < v_then, concat('−', toString(v_then - v_now)), 'no change'), ' since ', toString(toDayOfMonth(ref)), ' ', formatDateTime(ref, '%b'))) AS change
        FROM nightly WHERE night > newest - 30 ORDER BY time

panels.title: Over billed
panels.description:
Lines and pools whose use is above billed, in their own contract measure.

**Source:** n360.v_status_night  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the last 30 stored nights

targets.rawSql:
WITH nightly AS (SELECT data_date AS night, toUInt64(countIf(status = 'over billed')) AS value FROM n360.v_status_night
               WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY night),
             (SELECT max(night) FROM nightly) AS newest,
             (SELECT max(night) FROM nightly WHERE night <= newest - 30) AS ref_30,
             (SELECT min(night) FROM nightly) AS oldest,
             if(ref_30 IS NULL OR ref_30 = toDate(0), if(oldest < newest, oldest, NULL), ref_30) AS ref,
             (SELECT any(value) FROM nightly WHERE night = newest) AS v_now,
             (SELECT any(value) FROM nightly WHERE night = ref) AS v_then
        SELECT toDateTime(night) AS time, value, if(ref IS NULL, 'no earlier night stored', concat(multiIf(v_now > v_then, concat('+', toString(v_now - v_then)), v_now < v_then, concat('−', toString(v_then - v_now)), 'no change'), ' since ', toString(toDayOfMonth(ref)), ' ', formatDateTime(ref, '%b'))) AS change
        FROM nightly WHERE night > newest - 30 ORDER BY time

             (SELECT max(night) FROM nightly WHERE night <= newest - 30) AS ref_30,

             if(ref_30 IS NULL OR ref_30 = toDate(0), if(oldest < newest, oldest, NULL), ref_30) AS ref,

panels.title: At renewal risk
panels.description:
Lines and pools under 50% used with 120 days or fewer left (proposed, n360.settings).

**Source:** n360.v_status_night  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the last 30 stored nights

targets.rawSql:
WITH nightly AS (SELECT data_date AS night, toUInt64(countIf(renewal_risk)) AS value FROM n360.v_status_night
               WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) GROUP BY night),
             (SELECT max(night) FROM nightly) AS newest,
             (SELECT max(night) FROM nightly WHERE night <= newest - 30) AS ref_30,
             (SELECT min(night) FROM nightly) AS oldest,
             if(ref_30 IS NULL OR ref_30 = toDate(0), if(oldest < newest, oldest, NULL), ref_30) AS ref,
             (SELECT any(value) FROM nightly WHERE night = newest) AS v_now,
             (SELECT any(value) FROM nightly WHERE night = ref) AS v_then
        SELECT toDateTime(night) AS time, value, if(ref IS NULL, 'no earlier night stored', concat(multiIf(v_now > v_then, concat('+', toString(v_now - v_then)), v_now < v_then, concat('−', toString(v_then - v_now)), 'no change'), ' since ', toString(toDayOfMonth(ref)), ' ', formatDateTime(ref, '%b'))) AS change
        FROM nightly WHERE night > newest - 30 ORDER BY time

panels.title: % of billed now, and by the term end at the current rate
panels.description:
A bullet chart per line and pool (a pool once). Solid: % of billed now, in its status colour. Pale, after it: how much more the stored forecast's rate adds by the term end, so the bar ends at the forecast. The dashed line is 100% of billed. The label prints the true % and how much of the term has gone (Grafana OSS has no tick mark inside a bar). Bars stop at 250%. Sorted by status, then %. Lines with no reading (grey statuses) are in the table below.

**Source:** n360.v_contract_status (n360.v_line_pace, n360.forecast: rate never refitted)  
**Filter:** Customer; Status  
**Window:** start date to the data-through day; forecast to the term end

panels.title: Decisions due
panels.description:
Every line or pool needing a decision: over billed, set to exceed, at renewal risk, ended in the last 90 days, or ending within 90 days (proposed, n360.settings). At term end = the stored forecast's rate carried to the end of the term, as % of billed. Ended terms first, then soonest. Click a customer or a line to open it.

**Source:** n360.v_contract_status  
**Filter:** Customer; Status  
**Window:** the latest load; forecast to the term end

targets.rawSql:
SELECT display_name AS Customer, line_label AS Line, issue AS Issue, concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(end_date)), ' ', formatDateTime(end_date, '%b %Y')) AS `Term ends`,
               days_left AS `Days left`, pct_billed AS `% used`, forecast_end_pct AS `At term end`,
               status_shown AS Status, account, drill
        FROM (SELECT *, if(renewal_risk, 'renewal risk', status) AS status_shown FROM n360.v_contract_status) WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND status_shown IN (${status:singlequote}) AND decision_due
        ORDER BY days_left < 0 DESC, days_left, status_rank

panels.n360MayBeEmpty: no decision due for the selection

panels.title: Showing
panels.description:
How many lines the tables below show, and whether a filter is on. Clear it with the Status and Customer pickers (All), or the Clear filters link.

**Source:** n360.v_contract_status  
**Filter:** Customer; Status  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(toString(countIf(account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND if(renewal_risk, 'renewal risk', status) IN (${status:singlequote}))), ' of ', toString(countIf(account IN (${account:singlequote}))), ' lines and pools',
                      if(countIf(account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND if(renewal_risk, 'renewal risk', status) IN (${status:singlequote})) = countIf(account IN (${account:singlequote})), '', ' · filtered (Status / Customer above)')) AS shown
        FROM n360.v_contract_status

panels.title: Every line
panels.description:
Every contract line and pool (a pool once, its lines on the customer page), in its own contract measure. The bar is % of billed (full at 100%; the number is the true %). Grey statuses have no reading: "Not reported yet", never zero. Sort by any column; group by term-end quarter with its column; filter with Status and Customer. Click a customer or a line to open it.

**Source:** n360.v_contract_status (n360.v_line_pace, n360.contract_line, n360.forecast)  
**Filter:** Customer; Status  
**Window:** start date to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT display_name AS Customer, line_label AS Line, status_shown AS Status, pct_billed AS `% of billed`,
               pct_term AS `% of term`, used AS Used, billed AS Billed, forecast_end_pct AS `At term end`,
               concat(toString(toDayOfMonth(end_date)), ' ', formatDateTime(end_date, '%b %Y')) AS `Term ends`, days_left AS `Days left`, measure AS Measure,
               concat('Q', toString(toQuarter(end_date)), ' ', toString(toYear(end_date))) AS `Term-end quarter`,
               csm AS CSM, account, drill
        FROM (SELECT *, if(renewal_risk, 'renewal risk', status) AS status_shown FROM n360.v_contract_status) WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND status_shown IN (${status:singlequote})
        ORDER BY status_rank, pct_billed DESC
